insights.one_liner: Delft company that measures ground and asset movement from satellite radar (InSAR); a recognised visa sponsor offering a data internship in English.

culture.text: Turns satellite radar data into millimetre-level movement estimates and explains what they mean for clients' assets.
Welcomes students from geoscience, geodesy, remote sensing and civil engineering who like GIS and programming in Python, MATLAB or R.

open.text: SkyGeo Netherlands B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
Its one open job here, a data and AI internship in Delft, does not require Dutch.

worth_knowing.text: The internship drew about 200 applicants on LinkedIn on average, so apply early.
